id.description: Allocator-namespaced item id. {PROJECT}-S{n} = a seat's row on the laptop fabric; {PROJECT}-Z-S{n} = site Z; {PROJECT}-W{n}-S{k} = a row minted in worker {n}'s worktree (0.9.0_WK_{PROJECT}~{n}); {PROJECT}-Z-W{n}-S{k} composes, fabric first; {PROJECT}-C-S{k} = a row of the CVO's in the adjudication document (the gate requires C- on a NEW row under adjudications/ and refuses it elsewhere; the CVO's rows written before the coordinate stay as they are). The fabric coordinate is REQUIRED for site Z because both certifiers otherwise allocate the same sequence by construction -- measured 2026-08-21: 7 colliding ids, 14 distinct findings, zero identical. The allocator coordinate W{n} is REQUIRED for a worker's rows for the same reason inside one fabric: spine v3 gives every worker its own worktree index and the row gate allocates against the index it grades -- measured 2026-09-04: two allocators minted one S34 (record NFRA_COMPEFFICACY-S37). {k} restarts at 1 per coordinate; a seat's row carries no W; the gate requires W{n} to equal the committing worker's suffix. Existing ids are the seat form and stay as they are; nothing is renumbered. Bridged messages cite the namespaced id; a citation carries the vintage as <id>@<commit>.

project.description: L3 IDENTITY, half 1. The register project code this item belongs to. MUST equal the id's prefix -- the gate checks the two against each other rather than deriving one from the other, because two carriers of one quantity that are never compared are how drift starts. OPTIONAL HERE AND GATE-REQUIRED ON NEW ROWS ONLY, the same bound `spec_asserts` carries: ~190 rows predate this field and are not back-filled (Andrew-direct 2026-09-01, 'maintain now and prospectively'). WHY A FIELD AND NOT JUST THE ID PREFIX: a consumer that must regex an id to learn which project a row belongs to cannot REJECT a malformed one -- it silently mis-groups it, and grouping is the L8 monitor's entire job (Andrew-direct 2026-09-02: 'so that these can be properly grouped').

fabric.description: L3 IDENTITY, half 2, and the same enum as the project register's `fabric` key (to-pipeline-gate.py:72 FABRIC_ENUM). MUST agree with the id: `site-z` iff the id carries the `Z-` infix. Gate-checked against the id, OPTIONAL here, gate-required on NEW rows only. Before this field the fabric was carried ONLY by the presence-or-absence of an infix -- a claim expressed as a GAP IN A STRING, which no consumer can reject on.

class.description: INTERRUPTION RIGHT -- what the item does to the current turn. Orthogonal to hazard_standing. RULED FORM (CTO @a35da72725): 'latent hazard' is the PROSE name for (any class, ARMED), never an enum value.

hazard_standing.description: Whether the item, LEFT ALONE, harms through the process's FUTURE NORMAL operation. Orthogonal to class: a BLOCKING or OBSERVATION item may also be ARMED, and then it carries a disarm owner. Replaced the removed precedence rule (channel item NFRA_PIPELINE-S1).

adjudicates.description: L9 ADJUDICATION CARRIER. The channel is append-only, so the CVO dispositions an EXISTING item with a NEW row that names it here: this row's `disposition` becomes the named items' latest disposition (.tools/surprise-row-gate.py, gate (iii) second limb -- Andrew-direct 2026-09-03 'Recs approved'). Without this field an adjudication lives in prose ('S6 dispositions S2/S3/S5') where no gate can read it, and the L10 precondition 'every investigation CVO-checked' has no refuser. Every id named must exist under the project; a phantom target is refused. OPTIONAL: a row that adjudicates nothing omits it.

grades.description: L9 GRADE CARRIER for JUDGMENT criteria (spine v3 L9; annex v3.1 sections 4a and 8). A criterion a task order could not reduce to an invocation and an expectation is never self-graded by the worker and never graded by the checker; the CVO reads the proof-of-spec instance against the specification that issued it and its verdict lives HERE, one entry per criterion, on a row of the CVO's. Without this field a grade is free text in `one_line` or `notes` -- a summary field no consumer can reject on. OPTIONAL: a row that grades nothing omits it. A row carrying grades that adjudicates no item and opens nothing carries `disposition` DISMISSED_WITH_REASON with its reason naming it a grade record -- the enum has no record value and this version proposes none.

criterion.description: the criterion id as the task order names it (T6-AC7, B2-AC6): the same string the proof-of-spec instance's acceptance row carries, so the grade and the row it grades resolve to one id.

instance.description: the graded proof-of-spec instance as <path>@<commit> -- the vintage is the grade's grain; a grade without the commit grades nothing citable.

verdict.description: PASS = the output meets the specification's bar as read by the CVO; FAIL = it does not; NOT_EVALUATED = the CVO could not read it against the bar (the instance, the artifact or the bar unreachable) and says so rather than converting an instrument's limit into a verdict. No fourth value: a grade that is none of these is not a grade.

reason.description: the bar quoted or cited (PRD section, task-order clause) and what the output did against it; for NOT_EVALUATED, what was unreachable.

spec_asserts.description: STEP-7 TRIGGER, half 1: what the TO SAID, quoted or paraphrased tightly. Paired with `world_is`. The trigger is 'did I have to do something the TO did not say to do, or could I not do something the TO said to do?' -- a SPEC-vs-WORLD MISMATCH. Carrying BOTH halves is what keeps the worker judging FORM and never SIGNIFICANCE: a row that cannot state both is not a mismatch, it is an opinion. OPTIONAL in this schema and REQUIRED BY THE GATE ON NEW ROWS ONLY (.tools/surprise-row-gate.py) -- ~190 rows predate the field and are not back-filled, per Andrew-direct 2026-09-01 'this is a relatively new system ... maintain now and prospectively'.

world_is.description: STEP-7 TRIGGER, half 2: what the WORLD turned out to be. Paired with `spec_asserts`. See that field for the trigger, the prospective-only bound, and why both halves are required together.

allOf.comment: graduation is a GROUNDING bar: a GRADUATED item must be GROUNDED with nonempty evidence
a bare dismissal is the rot with a tidier label
ARMED obliges a named disarm owner WHATEVER the class -- this is the case the removed precedence rule could not express (the tsc specimen: OBSERVATION class, ARMED standing)
